Description

The Tarmac Muga at Wren Academy Enfield is a versatile outdoor sports facility available for hire, providing a quality space for a range of sporting activities.

The facility is suitable for netball and tennis, making it ideal for sports clubs, schools, teams, coaches and individuals looking for a reliable space to train, practise or play. Whether you're organising a regular training session, a competitive match or a casual game, the Tarmac Muga offers a practical and flexible environment for players of all abilities.

Available for both one-off and regular bookings, the facility is a great option for local sports groups and individuals looking for a convenient outdoor venue in Enfield.
